title: The plant's zones: preview stills, one zone each, in four palettes

centre.how: the centre of the smallest circle round OSM way 28877213 (the plant's site), for the rings and the dome alike; the six units' centroid (OSM power=generator ways 1572378821-30) lies 233 m from it, well under the guidance's precision (3-5 km, 15-30 km)

dome.footprint: the smallest circle round OSM way 28877213, as the zoom-out's zone
label: IAEA protection zone
proposed 6 Sep 2022, never agreed
no size published: “limited to the perimeter and the plant itself”
drawn on the plant’s site: its shape and height are ours
dome.statement: drawn: no size was ever published (Grossi: 'limited to the perimeter and the plant itself'); its shape and height are the film's; it fades to nothing toward its top, so it never closes: it was never agreed

paz.label: Precautionary action zone  ·  out to 3–5 km  ·  IAEA
paz.source: IAEA, EPR-NPP Public Protective Actions (2013), Table 3: suggested maximum radius

upz.label: Urgent protective action planning zone  ·  out to 15–30 km  ·  IAEA
upz.source: IAEA, EPR-NPP Public Protective Actions (2013), Table 3: suggested maximum radius

obs.label: Observation zone  ·  30 km  ·  Ukraine
obs.source: Ukrainian norms as reported; Ukrhydromet's daily radiological bulletin draws 30 km dashed round each plant (secondary sources, as the report says)

facts: seven IAEA-brokered repair truces (2025-26): no distances published
unsized.status: research only: no size, so not drawn (the user, 10 November 2026)

white.why: IAEA near-white, Ukraine a pale amber (the first design)

note: planning distances, not barriers: said here and in the README; no foot line on these previews (the user: no other text while the zones are shown one by one)

C.why: the shot's direction, closer on the plant, so the dome and its words read

wide.why: the whole 15 km ring on the ground, Nikopol and Marhanets at its edge, Enerhodar near the centre; as much of the 30 km ring as the frame holds

wide_blur_px.note: the tilt-shift kept at the shot's settings: at 42 km the depth across the frame is small, so it softens only the frame's far and near edges a little (as a real lens's depth of field would at this distance)

far_plain: beyond the land's box (17 km W, 23 km E, 19.5 km S, 28.5 km N of the plant) the ground is the look's far plain, a flat drawn ground in the land's mean colour; the rings run on over it
